• POUlman
rows.ARS:
Dark red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: POUlman
Exhibition name: Ingrid Bergman ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by L. Pernille Olesen (Denmark, before 1981). Bred by Mogens Nyegaard Olesen (Denmark, before 1981).
Introduced in Denmark by Poulsen Roser A/S as 'Ingrid Bergman'.
Introduced in New Zealand by South Pacific Roses Ltd. in 2018 as 'Love You Mum'.
rows.Bloom: Dark red. None to mild, mild fragrance. 30 to 35 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Large, double (17-25 petals), full (26-40 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, upright, well-branched. Medium, glossy, semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 2' to 39" (60 to 100cm). Width: 2' to 26" (60 to 65cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 4b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower. Heat tolerant. rain tolerant. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).

The denomination of this new rose is 'Ingrid Bergman. New Zealand - Patent No: 386 on 1 Oct 1987
